content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking help regarding the same issue you described – showing ON/OFF status on [product_name] operator device. When I inquired about upgrading firmware for better compatibility with [company_name] hardware, support informed me that such an upgrade is not possible. Could you explain how you managed to update to a newer firmware version and where I can download it? Thank you for any assistance.

You previously received a response in 2013 stating that upgrading the display firmware is not possible. To resolve this, you would need a new display with a higher firmware version, or try using Qx instead of Mx if not connected in your current project. Depending on your program setup, you might consider other options to show status, such as displaying an analog value (0 or 1) instead of ON or OFF. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user faces limitations with their [product_name] operator device related to visible ON/OFF status, and official support from [company_name] has confirmed that firmware upgrades are unavailable for this hardware revision. This has led to the user seeking alternative solutions and workarounds to address the display issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to upgrade the firmware of their [product_name] panel to improve its functionality and address display problems, and is searching for clear directions on how to obtain and apply the necessary firmware files if available.
